title: mime-tree: implement decode_body_value()
description:
Callers need decoded text content on demand without re-parsing the message. Implement in decode.rs: slice the body_range from raw bytes, transfer-decode, charset-convert to UTF-8 via encoding_rs. Respect max_bytes limit. Return DecodedBodyValue with is_truncated flag. This is the only decode path — no decoding happens at parse time.

Do NOT hand-roll transfer decoders:
- Base64: use the base64 crate
- QuotedPrintable: use the quoted_printable crate
- Identity/7bit/8bit/binary: pass through (slice only)

encoding_rs handles all charset conversion — do not hand-roll charset mapping.
acceptance_criteria: decode_body_value() output matches Python email.parser for a set of base64/QP/latin-1/utf-8 test parts; oracle is Python, not this crate
